subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3: Renewable Energy – Introducing Renewable Energy
outcomes: Name renewable and non-renewable energy sources.
Explain why some energy sources will run out.
Give my opinion on the best energy for Oman.

tf.s: Solar power comes from the sun.
tf.why: Yes! Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity.

tf.s: Coal, oil and gas are renewable energy sources.
tf.why: They are non-renewable because they will run out one day.

tf.s: Wind power uses turbines to generate electricity.
tf.why: Correct, the wind turns the turbines.

tf.s: Non-renewable energy exists in limited amounts.
tf.why: Right, that is why it will run out.

tf.s: Biofuel is made from living things or their waste.
tf.why: Well done, that is what biofuel is.

tf.s: Hydropower is energy that comes from the wind.
tf.why: Hydropower comes from moving water, not wind.

tf.s: Renewable energy comes from sources that will run out soon.
tf.why: Renewable sources do not run out, like the sun and wind.

tf.s: Geothermal energy uses heat from inside the ground.
tf.why: Yes, 'geo' means earth and 'thermal' means heat.

tf.s: Solar panels need wind to make electricity.
tf.why: Solar panels need sunlight, not wind.

tf.s: Oman is very sunny, so solar power can be a good choice there.
tf.why: Good thinking, lots of sun means lots of solar energy.

boxes.why: Coal is limited and will run out.

boxes.q: What does wind power use to make electricity?

boxes.why: When energy runs out, there is none left.

boxes.q: Fuel made from plants or their waste is…
boxes.why: 'Bio' means life, so biofuel comes from living things.
It uses natural heat under the earth.

boxes.q: Where does the electricity in our homes come from?
boxes.why: Electricity is generated from energy sources like gas or the sun.

mcq.q: Which of these is a renewable energy source?
mcq.why: The sun keeps shining, so solar power is renewable.

o: fuel made from living things or their waste
mcq.why: Biofuel comes from plants, animals or their waste.

mcq.q: What does a solar panel do?
mcq.why: Solar panels capture sunlight and make electricity.

mcq.q: Which group contains only non-renewable sources?
mcq.why: Coal, oil and gas will all run out.

mcq.q: Complete: A country with strong winds near the coast could build a ______.
mcq.why: Strong winds are perfect for wind turbines.

mcq.q: A town is next to a big, fast river. Which energy suits it best?
Sara says: 'This energy will never run out.' Which energy is she talking about?
mcq.why: The sun will not run out, so solar power is renewable.

mcq.q: Why will non-renewable energy run out?
o: It exists in limited amounts and cannot be renewed.
mcq.why: There is only a fixed amount of coal, oil and gas.

mcq.q: Why is solar power a good choice for Oman?
o: Oman has a lot of snow.
Oman has no sunlight in summer.
mcq.why: More sunshine means more solar electricity.

mcq.q: What is the main difference between renewable and non-renewable energy?
o: Renewable energy does not run out; non-renewable energy does.
Renewable energy is always more expensive.
Non-renewable energy comes from the sun.
mcq.why: The key idea is whether the source can run out.
